name: Main product — simple
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Main product — simple.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Product content layout
settings.info: Use blocks to add, remove, and reorder product information.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for product content layout. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.
